🇮🇳 India answer the T20I hammering — 6-wicket win over England at Edgbaston.

Axar Patel: 4/62 with the ball, unbeaten 57 with the bat, sealing the chase with Washington Sundar's 52* after Gill's 80 (retired hurt) laid the base.

England's 258 wasn't enough. POTM: Axar Patel. 🔥

tweet:
🖤 New Zealand hit back — 5-wicket win over West Indies at Providence.

West Indies were cruising at 63/0 before Jayden Lennox turned into an absolute menace, ripping out a career-best 5/19 to fold them for just 138. John Campbell's 43 was the only thing resembling resistance.

New Zealand's chase wasn't exactly serene either — 96/5 on a pitch spinning like a fairground ride — until Tom Latham (37*) and Mark Bracewell calmly walked them home.

New Zealand won by 5 wickets with 104 balls to spare. Player of the Match: Jayden Lennox. Series tied 1-1 — Providence giving nobody an easy day. 🔥
